## Privacy check

Do not include recovery words, private keys, passwords, tokens, precise coordinates,
private host addresses, or unredacted logs. Review screenshots before posting.
Public addresses and transaction hashes are optional and link activity publicly.
Report vulnerabilities privately to security@wrfcoin.com.
